summary: # Email Deliverability Maximizing the chances that your emails are delivered successfully to the recipients. ## Email Authentication **Required by Gmail/Yahoo/Microsoft** - unauthenticated emails will be rejected or spam-filtered. ### SPF (Sender Policy Framework) Specifies which servers can send email for your domain. ``` v=spf1 include:amazonses.com ~all ``` - Add TXT record to DNS
